priorityList: Use offensive cooldowns, trinkets, and potions when Black Arrow is active or ready to be cast.
Cast Kill Command if you have 0 stacks of Tip of the Spear to ensure your next ability is buffed.
Cast Kill Command if Black Arrow is about to come off cooldown and you have fewer than 2 stacks of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Black Arrow (Takedown) if you have at least 1 stack of Tip of the Spear.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you are about to cap at 2 charges.
Cast Boomstick (Wildfire Shells proc) if you have Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Wildfire Bomb if you have Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Moonlight Chakram if you have Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if your Raptor Swipe cleave buff is missing or about to expire.
Cast Raptor Strike (or Mongoose Bite) if you have Tip of the Spear active.
Cast Kill Command to generate Tip of the Spear stacks if Black Arrow is on cooldown.
Cast Wildfire Bomb as a filler if Tip of the Spear is not active.
Cast Black Arrow (Takedown) if available and you have no other priority actions.
Use Aspect of the Eagle if you are forced out of melee range (target distance > 6 yards).
